desc:
👋 Welcome to 🐶 Troll Dog Tower!

🐕 Grab other players with your leash
💀 Pull them wherever you want
🚀 Then THROW them across the map
😂 Troll your friends with crazy leash moves!

🔥 Can you reach the goal without throwing yourself?

🏆 Do you want to reach the top without getting thrown away?
😈 Or will you make everyone else fly first?

🎮 CONTROLS (PC):
Throw: X
Pull: E
Leash: M1

⭐ If you enjoy the game, don’t forget to 👍 LIKE, ⭐ FAVORITE, and SHARE it with your friends!
🎉 Join our group to receive items and the latest updates:
👉 https://www.roblox.com/share/g/513916638
